conflicts_resolved: Months to marry: search_visitor, sceptic and planner_couple asked which months are best and when the wind peaks. There is no official Mykonos weather station source in the pack, so no month is named as best; 'When to marry in Mykonos' stays on Smartraveller heat and wildfire. Not a fix item.

Airport section: uhnw wanted private cars, meet-and-greet and private aviation instead of the bus; funding_parent wanted organised transfers. The primary couple's guests include younger long-haul guests for whom the sourced bus and taxi facts are useful, and private logistics and transfer arrangements are deferred business details. Ruling: keep the bus and taxi lines, add the older-guest transfer-time question only (should_fix), make no transfer-arrangement claim.
Mykonos Grand shuttle: uhnw called it value talk; planner_couple (primary) praised it as a practical detail. Ruling for the primary persona: keep the shuttle, drop only 'complimentary'.

Exclusive use column: brief lists exclusive use as a comparison term, but three personas found the column empty. Ruling: drop the column from the table; exclusive use stays in every entry, the capacity section and the FAQ, so the primary couple still compares on it.

Deferred business details, never must-fix and not added to copy: commission and fee model and free first consultation (sceptic), real Mykonos wedding or case study and scale proof (planner_couple, sceptic, uhnw), who is on the ground on the day and the 2am contact (planner_couple, funding_parent), first call before booking (funding_parent), security integration and press control (uhnw), private aviation and meet-and-greet (uhnw), contract and deposit protection (funding_parent).

Who handles legal paperwork (funding_parent) and travel and medical insurance (funding_parent): no Advisor claim beyond brand-facts.md and nothing implying legal, church or religious paperwork help; insurance is not in the source pack, so no line is added.
Mykonos Town nightlife in peak season (planner_couple): no source in the pack, so the page does not characterise it.
Prices (search_visitor): no prices on this page; out of scope.
Non-Australian couples (search_visitor): 'quotes in AUD for Australian couples' is a brand fact and stays as written; the brief's reader is Australian.
